summary: CDW Corp filed an 8-K disclosing a $1 billion increase to its existing share repurchase program, effective immediately. The increase is incremental to approximately $484 million remaining under the program as of March 31, 2026. Purchases may occur in open market or private transactions based on market conditions; no specific price, premium, or timeline is set. The board authorized the increase without naming an advisor. The program does not obligate CDW to repurchase any shares and may be modified or suspended. The filing is a routine capital return disclosure with no M&A or special-situation catalyst; watch for ongoing buyback execution.
